mechanism: Voriconazole inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C19, potentially increasing primaquine metabolism inhibition and increasing risk of adverse effects including hemolytic anemia in G6PD-deficient patients.
action: Monitor for signs of hemolysis (jaundice, dark urine, fatigue) and consider alternative antimalarial if possible; ensure G6PD status is known before primaquine use.
